system.description: Creates one of the talismans described on Exalted p. 379. One net success per rating point required; 50 hours per rating point. Charms against disease require 1 dot Medicine per rating; good luck charms and walkaways require 1 Degree of Art of Geomancy per rating; warding charms require 1 Degree of Art of Warding per rating. A thaumaturge may substitute appropriate Procedures for Degrees, limiting talisman type and rating.
